name: Aethersprite Saber Design
description: The Aethersprite Saber Design was a custom lightsaber hilt owned by the droid Hunter J-3DI that he could wield for the Hunters of the Outer Rim competition on Vespaara as an alternative to his standard lightsaber. It was designed in a way that was meant to invoke the aesthetics of the Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptors used by members of the Jedi Order shortly before its collapse.
